items.source: Handle errors sent from the server side to clients, for example, errors from the "broke relay" because connectivity failed or the external broker sent an error message, etc.
items.translation: 处理从服务器端发送到客户端的错误，例如由于连接失败或外部代理发送错误消息等原因导致的来自 "broke relay" 的错误等。

items.source: the error message to send to the client, or null in which case no message will be sent.
items.translation: 要发送给客户端的错误消息，或为 `null` 的情况，此时将不发送任何消息。

items.source: Note that the STOMP protocol requires a server to close the connection after sending an ERROR frame. To prevent an ERROR frame from being sent, a handler could return null and send a notification message through the broker instead, for example, via a user destination.
items.translation: 请注意，STOMP 协议要求服务器在发送 ERROR 帧后关闭连接。为了防止发送 ERROR 帧，处理器可以返回 `null` 并通过代理发送通知消息，例如通过用户目的地。

items.source: A contract for handling sub-protocol errors sent to clients.
items.translation: 用于处理发送给客户端的子协议错误的合同。

items.source:
Handle errors thrown while processing client messages providing an
opportunity to prepare the error message or to prevent one from being sent.
items.translation: 处理在客户端消息处理过程中抛出的错误，提供准备错误消息或阻止发送该消息的机会。

items.source: clientMessage - the client message related to the error, possibly null if error occurred while parsing a WebSocket message
items.translation: clientMessage - 与错误相关的客户端消息，如果是在解析 WebSocket 消息时发生错误，则可能为 null。

items.source: ex - the cause for the error, never null
items.translation: ex - 错误的根本原因，永远不为 null
